name: @faqir-ui/vue
description: Vue 3 bindings for Faqir UI — components generated from registry manifests by `faqir bindings vue`; ships no CSS
//exports: Points at dist/, never at src/. The package used to resolve `main`, `module`, `types` and every `exports` condition to `./src/index.ts`, so the tarball held 110 TypeScript files and zero JS or declarations. That is not installable: Node 18 fails with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION, Node 24 with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, `tsc --moduleResolution node16` reports errors `skipLibCheck` cannot suppress (it skips .d.ts, and those were .ts), and a stock `next build` dies in `Module parse failed`. Only Vite worked, and Next only with `transpilePackages` — neither README said so. `tests/bindings/packaged-consumer.test.ts` installs the packed tarball and holds this shape.
